verdicts.title: Schur--Weyl duality for twin groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The twin group $TW_n$ on $n$ strands is the group generated by $t_1, \dots, t_{n-1}$ with defining relations $t_i^2=1$, $t_it_j = t_jt_i$ if $|i-j|>1$.
